verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own marketing says it lets teams build workflows for SLAs, automatic trial extensions, and discount offers, which matches the story's named outcomes. That claim is a single homepage line with no workflow-builder documentation, and nothing ties those workflows to feedback-event triggers. Webhooks that react to feedback are only a developer building block and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: workflow builder documentation, evidence that triggers fire on feedback events, configuration details for SLA, trial, and discount actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build automated workflows for SLAs, trial extensions, and discount offers triggered by feedback events

citations.quote: Build workflows for SLAs, automatically extending trials, offering discounts, and much more.
